findings.explanation: Proposed. The American Academy of Dermatology says products containing retinol or benzoyl peroxide may make skin more sensitive, and exfoliating while using them may worsen dryness or cause breakouts. Confirmed retinol and confirmed glycolic acid, class exfoliant, are both in this routine.
findings.reason: Proposed. The rule matches retinol, benzoyl peroxide, or tretinoin with class exfoliant. Repeated retinol rows are one identity. Order is not a match condition.
limitations: Proposed rules only. This is not a team-approved safety assessment. Severity, when present, is display priority and not a clinical grade.
